name: Apply psychology to parental buying behavior
prompt: How do we convince [Local Language] parents to pay for EduPlatform instead of traditional tuition?
expected_behavior: Applies the 'Sunk Cost Fallacy' of private tuition
Uses Mental Accounting to reframe the cost (e.g., 'less than a cup of chiya a day')
Leverages Authority Bias (Curriculum Board syllabus alignment, international awards)
Addresses Loss Aversion (fear of child failing local exam/local exam)
References marketing-psychology-framework.md

name: Optimize pricing tiers using psychology
prompt: How should we structure our pricing packages to maximize revenue?
expected_behavior: Recommends the Decoy Effect (Good-Better-Best pricing)
Applies Charm Pricing/Left-Digit Bias for [Local Currency] values
Suggests bundling subjects to increase perceived value
Explains the psychological rationale behind the structure

name: Increase student engagement using B=MAP
prompt: Students sign up but don't finish the videos. How do we fix this?
expected_behavior: Applies the BJ Fogg Behavior Model (B=MAP)
Analyzes Motivation (gamification, leaderboards)
Analyzes Ability/Friction (video length, bandwidth, language)
Analyzes Prompts (SMS/messaging app reminders, Zeigarnik effect loops)
Provides actionable product/marketing tweaks

name: Social proof for B2B school sales
prompt: What psychological triggers work best when selling to school principals?
expected_behavior: Applies Authority Bias (PABSON endorsements, awards)
Uses Bandwagon Effect ('Join 50+ innovative schools')
Addresses Status-Quo Bias (reducing the friction of changing systems)
Frames ROI in terms of enrollment growth and parent satisfaction

name: General psychology request
prompt: Give me some psychological principles to use in our marketing
expected_behavior: Checks .agents/<productname>/product.md for product context
Recognizes product as our product
Asks task-specific intake questions (behavior, audience, journey stage)
Presents 3-4 highly relevant principles (e.g., Loss Aversion, Endowed Progress)
Follows iterative chatty approach
